title: Electrical Power
text: Power (P) is the rate at which electrical energy is converted to other forms (light, heat). Unit is watt (W), where 1 W = 1 J/s.

title: Three Power Equations
text: P = IV is the basic formula. Using V = IR: P = I(IR) = I²R. Using I = V/R: P = (V/R)V = V²/R.

title: Choosing the Right Formula
text: We know P and V, and need R. Use P = V²/R, rearranged to R = V²/P. Then use I = V/R or I = P/V for current.
